capabilities: Render frontmatter values from dated notes as interactive yearly heatmap grids
Build and edit tracker codeblocks through a form with live preview instead of YAML
Compute statistics and user-defined insights such as streaks and totals
Export tracked data plus daily note content as Markdown or HTML reports
Open the note behind a filled square or create one from an empty square
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.4.0+; dataviewjs blocks additionally need 'Enable JavaScript Queries' in Dataview settings. Includes a no-migration path from heatmap-calendar and an 'Example Vault' with working trackers.
intentEvidence: Heatmap Tracker began as a rewrite of the excellent heatmap-calendar-obsidian by Richardsl, and grew from there.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn values written in daily notes into a visual year-at-a-glance activity grid with clickable days.

relations.evidence: Heatmap Tracker began as a rewrite of the excellent heatmap-calendar-obsidian by Richardsl, and grew from there.
Heatmap Tracker uses Dataview to read data out of your notes.

summary: Renders data from dated notes as an interactive, GitHub-style yearly heatmap with statistics, custom insights, and report export.
